segments.text: Hey everyone, today I'm sharing my honest results from thirty days of sixteen-eight intermittent fasting.
Sixteen-eight means I ate everything within an eight hour window, from noon to eight p.m., and fasted the other sixteen hours.
Before I started I talked to my doctor, because I take medication for blood pressure, and she was fine with it as long as I tracked how I felt.
The first week was rough. I was genuinely hungry every morning around ten, and by day three I had a headache most afternoons.
What fixed it was drinking a lot more water and adding a pinch of salt to it, and by day six the hunger basically went away.
Energy-wise, I was tired the first few days, but in week two I actually felt more focused in the mornings than before.
A lot of you asked about the eating window, so I want to talk about timing for a second.
I picked noon to eight because it fits my work schedule, and dinner with my family is at seven, so I never had to skip it.
Some people do ten to six instead, and honestly the exact window matters less than being consistent every day.
Is it safe? For me it felt completely safe, and honestly I think pretty much anyone can do this.
